description: Set or clear an initiative's Status description — the same write as 'Save status' in the console. It replaces the current line (one line, overwritten on every edit; the history is in the audit trail), is CLIENT-VISIBLE on program reports and their shared links, and is allowed at every initiative status. Pass null or an empty string to clear it. Requires `write` scope and a key owner who can edit initiatives (and act on the initiative's owning team); the write is audited as the key owner.

latestStatus.description: The current status line. null or "" clears it.

name: anyforge_set_initiative_status
title: Set initiative status
